info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Card Network Participant Facility-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the onboarding and management of card network participant facilities within the banking system. It allows institutions to establish new facilities, ensuring compliance with network standards and operational requirements. Ideal for financial institutions and service providers, this API streamlines the process of adding participant facilities, thereby enhancing connectivity and transaction efficiency in card networks. Use cases include initiating facility registrations and updating facility attributes to maintain accurate network participation.

post.summary: Create a new card network participant facility.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new facility associated with a card network participant. It accepts the necessary information to establish the facility and returns the details of the created facility.

requestBody.description: This endpoint is used to create a new card network participant facility. The request must include the necessary details of the facility in the JSON format.

201.description: Resource created successfully, confirming the new card network participant facility.
